MON.body:
You earn it twice — once for the skill, once for the respect.
Bad cut. Long day. Back on it tomorrow.
Then one morning the new apprentice asks you how.
MON.donation: 30% of every profit funds breast cancer research.
MON.cta: Save this for the hard days.
MON.suggested_visual: A worn canvas tool bag on a concrete floor in low evening light, single work glove beside it.
MON.extra:
Beat 1: Nobody *hands* you the toolbag || Open tight on a worn tool bag, hard cut in.
Beat 2: You earn it *twice*. Skill, then respect. || Quick cuts of hands working, no faces.
Beat 3: Bad cut. Long day. *Again* tomorrow. || Slow push on a dim jobsite at end of day.
Beat 4: Then the new girl asks *you* how. || Warm turn, morning light.
Beat 5: *Save* this for the hard days. || Hold on logo.

THU.body:
No number. No proof. No thanks.
So here's ours in plain numbers: 30% of profit. Not revenue games, not "up to." The actual take-home, split with the research.
THU.donation: 30% of every profit funds breast cancer research — every order, no asterisk.
THU.cta: DM PINK and I'll send you the link.
THU.suggested_visual: Stark type-only card: the phrase 'a portion of proceeds' struck through, 30% stamped beneath it.
THU.extra:
Beat 1: "A portion of proceeds" means *nothing* || Hard open on the phrase, struck through.
Beat 2: No number. No proof. No *thanks*. || Fast cuts, tight type.
Beat 3: Ours is *30%* of profit. || Big number slams in.
Beat 4: Every order. No *asterisk*. || Hold, let it sit.
Beat 5: DM *PINK* for the link. || Close on logo.
